spec.kitLine: ATK ▲ 55.31% of the skill user's ATK
spec.scope: Generic ATK buff, no attack-type scoping — but magnitude is CASTER-scaled ('of the skill user's ATK' = flat add of 55.31% × Anis's final ATK), not a % of the target's own ATK.
spec.durationSemantics: durationSec: 10 (wall-clock seconds, literal 'for 10 sec' — no round count).
spec.triggerIdentity: fullBurstEnter — 'Activates when entering Full Burst' fires on ANY team Full Burst, including rotations where the co-B3 (helm) bursts, not only Anis's own casts. NOT burstCast.
spec.targetSet: All Electric Code allies INCLUDING self. The redacted TargetDef list has class/weapon-typed ally targets but no element-typed one — element-typed targeting is a possible schema GAP the driver must resolve (not silently widen to {kind:'allies'}). On controlComp (liter/crown/helm all Iron) the only Electric unit is Anis herself, so the block is effectively self-only there.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Plain atkPct scaling each TARGET's own ATK (over-credits any higher-ATK Electric carry), and/or target {kind:'allies'} untyped (buffs the whole Iron control team), and/or keyed to burstCast (misses helm-rotation FBs).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: onEvent buffApply during EVERY fullBurstStart (helm rotations included): stat lands ONLY on Anis's slot in controlComp (liter/crown/helm receive nothing), and the granted ATK delta equals 55.31% × Anis's final ATK. Caster-vs-target scaling is invisible on controlComp (caster==sole target) — assert it on a comp with a second, higher-ATK Electric ally: delta must NOT scale with that ally's ATK.
spec.inertness: Non-Electric allies' effectiveAtk must not move; buff must also fire on FBs Anis did not burst into.

spec.scope: Weapon-state modifier — reload duration. This IS damage (taxonomy #6): it raises shots fired AND, via faster magazine cycling, raises skill2 lastBullet proc frequency. Never 'skip: defensive'.
spec.triggerIdentity: fullBurstEnter (same ■ header as the ATK line), any team FB.
spec.targetSet: All Electric Code allies incl. self → effectively self-only on controlComp.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Dropped as a non-damage/defensive stat; or applied as a generic team buff to all four allies; or keyed burstCast so it misses non-Anis FBs.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Anis's reload-event spacing shrinks during the 10 s post-FB window: with reloadFrames 141 (~2.35 s base), reload completions inside the window come measurably faster than outside it, so her shot count per FB window rises. On controlComp, liter/crown/helm reload cadence unchanged.
spec.inertness: Non-Electric allies' reload cadence and shot counts unchanged.

spec.kitLine: Deals 382.42% of final ATK as damage
spec.scope: Instant flatDamage rider, % of final ATK. Not a DoT, no charge/crit/core scoping in text. Per methodology rule 9: takes the +50% FB bonus by landing TIMING (default ON), no +30% range (noRange), crits at caster rate, NO core.
spec.triggerIdentity: lastBullet — 'when firing the last bullet', per-magazine. Counts ROUNDS: SG ammo is 5 rounds; hitsPerShot 10 is PELLETS and must not feed this trigger. Critically COUPLED to burst's Max Ammo ▼: a ~1-round magazine during the burst window fires this on nearly every trigger pull.
spec.targetSet: '2 enemy units with the highest final ATK' — solo-boss sim has ONE enemy, so exactly ONE 382.42% instance per proc, never ×2.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Doubling the hit (×2 'for 2 enemies') against the single boss; or hitCount keyed to pellet hits (10× too frequent); or shotFired (5× too frequent outside burst); or a static proc rate that ignores the burst-window magazine shrink.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: damage events with srcSlot==anis, bucket flatDamage: count outside the burst window == her reload count (one per 5-round magazine), each at mult 382.42% ×1 instance; count INSIDE her 10 s burst window jumps to ~one per trigger pull (magazine ≈1 round). Red under ×2-per-proc, red under pellet-counted, red if window frequency doesn't rise.
spec.inertness: No proc without a magazine exhaustion; no core bucket on these hits.

spec.scope: Interruption-parts-scoped damage. The scope-lock boss is partless and hit location never changes damage; no StatKey exists for parts damage.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Laundered into attackDamagePct/damageTakenPct as a generic 6.91% Damage Up — over-credits every hit on a partless boss.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Deleting this line from the override changes total damage by exactly 0; no buffApply for any generic damage stat at lastBullet cadence.
spec.inertness: Must move nothing anywhere; recorded verbatim in `unmodeled` (no `ignored` block — validator rejects those).

spec.scope: Self weapon-state change and the kit's ENGINE, not a downside: 5 × (1−0.7392) = 1.304 → ~1-round magazine (⚑ rounding convention floor-vs-round-min-1 is not in the text) → lastBullet fires ~every pull → multiplies skill2 procs and reload count for 10 s.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast — a self mode in the unit's OWN burst block fires ONLY on rotations Anis bursts (cd 40 s ≈ every other rotation). NOT fullBurstEnter: with helm co-B3 in controlComp these diverge — helm's rotations must NOT shrink Anis's magazine.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Skipped as a defensive/self-nerf line (kills the whole burst loop); or keyed fullBurstEnter (fires every rotation, ~doubling proc income); or sign-flipped to ▲.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: During Anis's own 10 s burst windows only: reload events ≥3–4 (vs ~1 per comparable non-burst 10 s) and skill2 flatDamage procs spike to ~per-pull. On helm-burst rotations the magazine stays 5 and proc cadence stays baseline — red under fullBurstEnter keying.
spec.inertness: No magazine change outside her own burst windows; teammates' ammo untouched.

spec.scope: Self reload-speed. Damage-relevant: with the ~1-round magazine she reloads every pull, so reload time dominates her burst-window shot economy. Stacks with skill1's 49.28% on her own rotations (burst cast precedes FB entry; both 10 s windows overlap) — ⚑ stacking convention (additive in one speed pool vs multiplicative) is not kit-stated.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Skipped as defensive; or keyed fullBurstEnter; or granted to allies.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: On an Anis-burst rotation her per-cycle (shot+reload) period inside the window reflects BOTH reload buffs (~141f / combined factor), strictly shorter than a helm-burst-rotation FB window where only skill1's applies — shot count per window differs accordingly.
spec.inertness: Teammates' reload cadence unchanged; no effect on rotations she doesn't burst.

spec.scope: Elemental-ADVANTAGE-scoped damage (taxonomy #8): lifts the element-advantage bucket beyond the clean ×1.10 — ONLY live when Anis is advantaged (Electric vs a Water boss). NOT a generic Damage Up.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast, self (same ■ block as the ammo/reload lines).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Encoded as attackDamagePct (or ungated elementDamagePct that pays out vs ANY boss) — over-credits every burst window against non-Water bosses, including the controlComp Fire boss where the line must be worth exactly zero.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: controlComp boss is Fire (Electric not advantaged): withPatchedOverride deleting this line changes totals by exactly 0. Against a Water boss, damage events in her burst windows carry an element factor > 1.10 (×1.10 × (1+0.4224) shape); outside her windows, back to plain ×1.10.
spec.inertness: Zero movement vs Fire/neutral bosses; zero on helm-burst rotations.

skill2: Damage to Interruption Parts ▲ 6.91% for 10 sec.

notes: This kit is one coupled machine: burst Max Ammo ▼ (5→~1 round) is the multiplier on skill2's lastBullet nuke and on both reload-speed buffs — the single highest-risk shared-prior misread is treating the ammo cut as a skippable self-downside or keying the burst self-block to fullBurstEnter (controlComp has helm co-B3, so burstCast-vs-FB-enter diverges every other rotation; assert Anis-burst rotations differ from helm-burst rotations). Second expected misread: '2 enemy units with highest final ATK' doubled against the single sim boss — must be exactly 1 instance. Third: skill1's 'of the skill user's ATK' modeled as target-own atkPct — invisible on controlComp (caster==sole Electric target) so the distinguishing test needs a second Electric ally; also no element-typed ally TargetDef exists in the redacted schema, so the driver must show how 'all Electric Code allies' is expressed rather than silently widening to all allies. Fourth: elemental-advantage buff must be inert vs the Fire control boss (a generic Damage-Up encoding is red there). ⚑ open conventions the driver must state: ammo rounding at 1.304 (floor/round, min 1), reload-speed stacking (additive pool vs multiplicative) and its formula direction (time÷(1+x) vs time×(1−x)), and rider FB/crit defaults (FB-by-timing ON, noRange, no core per methodology rule 9). lastBullet counts ROUNDS (5), never the SG's 10 pellets.
